title: If I go away
author: Mrinmoy Kumar Nath
text:
Someday If I go away from you
Donot blame me
Rather regret your self
For not being able to
Keep me with you.
If I never come back again
Then also donot blame me
But blame your self
For not being able to
Bring me back.
Our life is like that
We donot know
Who will come
Who will go away from our life
But the past days
Remain as a sweet memory in every one`s heart.
stanzas: Someday If I go away from you
If I never come back again
Who will go away from our life
Remain as a sweet memory in every one`s heart.
